data.title: Offer of Employment – Senior Data Engineer
data.summary: Example Analytics, Inc. (People Operations, San Francisco) offers Tomás Herrera the position of Senior Data Engineer, working remotely from Germany through an employer of record, starting 5 May 2025 at an annual base salary of €92,000. The signed offer letter must be returned by 26 March 2025, or the offer lapses.
data.explanation: This is a job offer, not yet a binding contract. To accept it, you need to sign the enclosed offer letter and send it back to People Operations by the deadline shown. If you miss that deadline, the offer automatically lapses and the position may no longer be available. Review the salary, start date and remote-work arrangement carefully before signing, and consider seeking advice (e.g. on taxes or social insurance as a remote worker for a US employer) if anything is unclear before you commit.
